counter.model_evidence_text: CECO Environmental announced a definitive agreement to acquire Profire Energy for an all-cash consideration of $125 million, or $2.55 per share. This acquisition aims to expand CECO's leadership in environmental solutions for industrial markets by integrating Profire's burner management technology and combustion control systems. The transaction is expected to close in Q1 2025 and will provide cost synergies and enhance Profire's growth through CECO's international operations.

Foley & Lardner represented CECO Environmental Corp. in its proposed $125 million acquisition of Profire Energy, Inc. This acquisition will further advance CECO Environmental's position as a leading environmental solutions provider in industrial markets by integrating Profire Energy's burner management technology and combustion control systems. The Foley deal team was led by partners Steven Cade, Jessica Lochmann, and Clyde Tinnen.
